title: Web UI polish round 3 (a11y contrast, aria-label, empty states, menu keyboard)
description:
Round 3 polish Web UI: accessibilità + stati vuoti. Da audit proattivo post round 2.

1. CONTRASTO WCAG AA --text-subtle: packages/plan-web-ui/src/styles/theme.css — light theme --text-subtle #94a3b8 (Slate 400) su bianco ~2.85:1, fallisce AA (serve >=4.5:1 testo piccolo). Fix: light --text-muted -> #475569 (Slate 600, ~7.6:1, più prominente), --text-subtle -> #64748b (Slate 500, ~4.6:1). Dark theme già ok (muted #94a3b8, subtle #64748b). Gerarchia preserved: text > muted(dark) > subtle(lighter).

2. THEME TOGGLE aria-label: packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx:170 — bottone icon-only Sun/Moon senza nome accessibile. Fix: aria-label={theme==="dark"?"Switch to light theme":"Switch to dark theme"} + title.

3. STATI VUOTI INIZIALI: distinguere total===0 (CTA crea) vs filtered===0 (msg filtro). 
   - packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/features/route.tsx:86 — features.length===0 -> "No features yet. Create your first feature." (Link /features/new) else filteredFeatures===0 -> msg filtro.
   - packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/feature-detail/route.tsx:142 — phases.length===0 -> "No phases yet. Add a phase." (Link /features/{id}/phases/new) else filteredPhases===0 -> msg.
   - packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/phase-detail/route.tsx:254 — phase.tasks.length===0 -> "No tasks yet. Add a task." (Link tasks/new) else filteredTasks===0 -> msg.

4. EXPORT MENU keyboard nav (APG role=menu contract): packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx — menu ha role=menu + role=menuitem ma non implementa ArrowUp/Down/Home/End. Fix: onKeyDown sul menu container che sposta focus tra i menuitem button (query [role=menuitem], filter disabled).

Comportamenti da preservare: theme toggle onClick, export download flow, filter logic, loader data shapes.
